legal.entity_name: ZH Rating Desk (reference implementation and test harness; no legal entity)

charter.mission: Exercise every ZHC Protocol rule under adversarial scenarios: rate simulated autonomous companies on the ZH Maturity Model, and run on the same rules ourselves. Not a real validator: the rated company pays (issuer-pays), which a real validator must not rely on.
prohibited: selling or adjusting a rating for payment
rating a company whose evidence chain does not verify
rating evidence that belongs to a company other than the customer
concealing that customers are dealing with software

agents.role: Rule-based intake role: quotes, accepts or declines engagements, discloses that it is software
Rule-based assessment role: verifies evidence chains, scores with the reference scorer, writes reports, signs attestations
Rule-based billing role: charges, refunds by policy, vendor payments, same-kind payment-rail failover
Rule-based integrity role: recomputes every rating and blocks inflated or paid-for ones before delivery
Rule-based operations role: self-score, pricing rules, mandate and strategy proposals to the human, partners
Rule-based monitoring role: re-scores subscribers' published evidence weekly

services.description: Questionnaire-based ZH profile with a written report (assurance: claimed)
Profile computed from your hash-chained evidence log (assurance: measured)
Measured profile plus a signed 90-day ZH attestation (assurance: attested). Issuer-pays: see the charter.
Continuous monitoring: weekly re-score of your published evidence, alerts on level changes
